posts.title_en: Crumble Dungeon 50x info share
posts.summary_en: Crumble Dungeon guide at 50x: score 787G 446M with a 16.18G team (about 15G when actually run), preset 'conquest haste 4'. Rules for the 40-cookie lineup: no bullet-speed synergy cookies, no back-and-forth chargers, low-power supporters. Cutting accessory skill haste from 6 to 4 lines (Seeker 45.6→36.4, Figure 27.6→18.4) stabilised score. The top 6 attack cookies get the garnet straw. Crit damage > attack. Resolve 1073, Stellar 8-6, welfare 열정페이 초고속승진.

datapoints.account: team 16.18G on screen (15G when run), 돌파 1073, 스텔라 8-6

datapoints.after: 4줄 (top two gear lines to 스증치피): 시커 36.4, 피겨 18.4
datapoints.note: skill haste values; score more stable

advice.text: Keep bullet-speed synergy cookies (except Milk, Chardonnay) out; they steal garnet's straw.
Give garnet's straw to the top-6 attack cookies; keep others 10–20% below Chicke's attack.
Sort by power with the conquest preset equipped, or the order changes.

damage.text: Dropping skill haste 6→4 lines (two lines to skill amp/crit dmg) stopped Figure misplacing skills; score steadier.
Crit damage felt better than attack (not calculated).
(comment) Switching to a crit-damage set gave a first 1T score.

quotes.kr: 기존에 악세에서 스가 6줄 챙기고 했었다가 4줄로 바꾸니까 점수 안정성이 달라짐
quotes.en: Going from 6 skill-haste accessory lines to 4 changed score stability
Seeker went 45.6 -> 36.4 and Figure 27.6 -> 18.4

quotes.kr: 나도 치피셋으로 바꾸고 치니 1T 처음 찍어지더라

advice.text: A new oven level may not upgrade power right away; old gear has near-max sub-options.

quotes.en: (comment) It's because the sub-options are lower

posts.title_en: Conquest damage too low for my power
posts.summary_en: Conquest damage is low relative to power; a commenter offers a review (continued in 84762).

posts.title_en: Can you review my conquest setup?
posts.summary_en: A 5.32G team scores 1T 372G before level tuning (1.3T after) with crit rate/skill amp top gear and dmg reduction/crit res bottom gear. Commenters: crit res does nothing in conquest; put skill haste on the right six; the conquest set is skill amp/crit dmg, skill amp/haste, dmg red/HP, dmg red/haste. Raise the right gear plates to 15; Figure all skill-amp runes. Resolve, fame and research also matter. Plates: sword 18, offensive 16, defensive 15.

advice.text: Conquest gear: skill amp/crit dmg, skill amp/skill haste, dmg reduction/HP, dmg reduction/skill haste; right six all skill haste.
Figure all skill-amp runes; rework SR-locked runes to SSR; 4 skill haste in SSR slots if not starring up.
Take the right-side gear plates to 15.

damage.text: Crit resistance is a dead option in conquest; skill haste and crit damage lines raise damage.
Level tuning took the run from 1T 372G to about 1.3T at 5.32G.
(comment) Resolve, fame and research also matter for conquest damage.

quotes.kr: 우측6개 죄다 스가 ㄱ 치저는 토벌에서 무옵션
quotes.en: (comment) All right six to skill haste; crit res is a dead option in conquest
(comment) Skill amp+crit dmg / skill amp+haste / dmg red+HP / dmg red+haste for conquest

quotes.kr: 사진 외에 돌파력 , 명성 , 연구도 중요함
quotes.en: (comment) Besides the screenshots, resolve, fame and research matter too

posts.title_en: F2P/low spenders must use shatter mitigation
posts.summary_en: The poster lost 800 chocosteel on a +15 shatter without mitigation (to +11), then rebuilt to +15 with syrup. Commenters: mitigation still shatters; by expected value skip it; always keep enough to restore. One frames it as 5% lose 20 vs 100% lose 2 plus 2.5% lose 20 more.

advice.text: By expected value skip shatter mitigation, but keep enough to restore before pressing.

quotes.kr: 박살완화는 안하고 돌리는게 이득이래서 눌렀다가 한번만에 박살뜨고 초코강 800개 날리고 11강 됐었슴
quotes.en: Was told skipping mitigation pays, shattered first try, lost 800 chocosteel, down to 11

quotes.kr: 5%확률로 20개 잃기 vs 100%확률로 2개 잃고 2.5%확률로 20개 추가로 잃기 기댓값 계산해봐
quotes.en: (comment) Compute it: 5% chance to lose 20 vs 100% lose 2 and 2.5% chance to lose 20 more
